sources.title: nkthebass/tinybrainbot-25m-v4-base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 25M-parameter language model trained from scratch on 11B tokens, part of the TinyBrainBot v4 series. 25.2M parameters in the transformer itself, plus a 5.4M tied embedding for its 14k vocabulary (30.6M total).
